certificate_wording: Mastemy Certificate of Completion — Business Valuation Basics for Managers

learning_outcomes.text: Explain why and when a business or asset is valued
Describe the main valuation approaches and when each is appropriate
Apply simple multiples-based valuation and interpret the result
Outline discounted cash flow mechanics and the role of the discount rate
Identify the key assumptions and sensitivities that drive a valuation
Communicate a valuation range and its limitations honestly

integrative_case: A manager evaluating a small bolt-on acquisition must triangulate a defensible value using multiples and a simple DCF, then present a range and its key sensitivities to the board. This is general business education, not investment advice.
